params.caption: 🎮 WoW: Forever gets its first big post-launch tweaks Blizzard pushed a November 8 hotfix that raises kill experience inside dungeons by 50%, so repeat runs feel more rewarding. A round of class changes goes live on November 10, marking the game's first real balance pass since launch. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 22:03 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot #WorldOfWarcraft #Blizzard #GamingNews
